column2: Good morning everyone, and welcome back to the show. Today we are talking about coffee.
Thanks for having me. I have to admit, I drink about five cups a day.
Five cups? That is honestly a lot. I stopped at two after my doctor gave me a warning.
So Daniel, what got you into coffee in the first place?
My grandfather owned a small roastery in Bristol. I grew up smelling fresh beans every morning.
That sounds wonderful. I grew up with instant coffee and nothing else.
Let's talk about the science. Does caffeine really improve focus?
Yes, in moderate amounts. But the effect fades if you drink it all day.
Exactly. And sleep matters more than any cup of coffee.
Great point. Thank you both for joining us today.
